But Peps 0 = Q 0 1 is the deterministic law concentrated on (true, true, true). For every t, the point mass at the all-true assignment witnesses AIFeasible t (Peps 0): its diagonal law is the tensor power of that deterministic law, and its injectable marginals and ancestral products are the corresponding deterministic laws. Hence the rejecting-order set defining tminAI is empty, so by Nat.sInf its value is 0; the lower bound fails. Therefore h0 cannot be deleted.
